projects.title: IBM Polymer Discovery
projects.description:
http://posra.nationbuilder.com/

We are extending the open source application osra, which is an optical chemical diagram reader written in C++ and uses libraries potrace and openbabel.  It convert an image of a chemical diagram into SMILES, SDF, etc. notations.  We are extending the software to recognize polymers and formulate a data model to query on the database of polymers recognized.
• Wrote image processing code using the GraphicsMagick library in C++, which alters the image by removing brackets and parenthesis in chemical diagrams.
